name: vx4-phasec-early-converge-switch-d1-d4-20270506-20270512
qualityPolicyNotes: Vx-4 Phase C reserved/special early convergence (serial 50) follows A/49 (Vx-3). Add a dedicated, default-off --enable-preclass-early-converge switch and a classifier-driven early-converge candidate path: high-confidence reserved/special classifications with rir=none short-circuit to unknown for implicit (no -h) queries; unknown/low-confidence and allocated/legacy keep the legacy strategy; explicit -h stays bypassed; --disable-address-preclass remains the full rollback. The route decision gains an early_converge candidate slot emitted as a distinct PRECLASS-DECISION action. Default behavior stays unchanged (default off); the default-on migration is reserved for a separate review. Per user direction, project documentation edits are handled separately outside this A/B task definition.
